Inline helpers for pacing CU consumption and computing enabled bank count.

# Purpose
This header defines a small pacing helper for the packer. It stores the block start and end time, the estimated CU budget, and the current remaining CU count in `fd_pack_pacing_t`. The inline functions [`fd_pack_pacing_init`](<#fd_pack_pacing_init>), [`fd_pack_pacing_update_consumed_cus`](<#fd_pack_pacing_update_consumed_cus>), and [`fd_pack_pacing_enabled_bank_cnt`](<#fd_pack_pacing_enabled_bank_cnt>) set the pacing state, update it from measured CU use, and compute how many banks should be active at a given time. The code uses the remaining CU budget and the time left in the slot to decide how much parallel work the packer should allow.
